notes: Monthly operating forecast for the shared Yomu services. Figures are honest estimates of recurring infrastructure cost, not a fundraising target. The effective donation goal is max(sum of line items, floorGBP). Update line items when infrastructure changes; the /goal and /status endpoints read this file at build time. USD lines assume GBP/USD ~= 0.75 (1 USD ~= 0.75 GBP). Sources: Cloudflare Workers Paid plan 5 USD/mo; R2 storage 0.015 USD/GB-month, egress free; R2 Class B ops 0.36 USD/million; .com registration ~10.44 USD/yr at-cost.

lineItems.label: Cloudflare Workers Paid plan
lineItems.detail: Shared plan covering yomu-support, yomu-audio, and edge (jpdb) Workers. Includes 10M requests + 30M CPU-ms/month.

lineItems.label: R2 audio bucket storage
lineItems.detail: yomu-audio R2 bucket, ~8 GB of pronunciation audio at 0.015 USD/GB-month, with headroom for growth. Egress is free on R2.

lineItems.label: R2 audio read operations
lineItems.detail: Class B (read) operations serving audio and the audio index manifest to readers.

lineItems.label: yomureader.com domain
lineItems.detail: Primary domain registration (~10.44 USD/yr at-cost) amortised monthly. Covers the apex plus audio, support, and edge subdomains.

lineItems.label: D1 + KV donation state
lineItems.detail: D1 donation ledger and KV (FX cache, manual provider totals, webhook state) for the support Worker.

lineItems.label: API usage and test devices
lineItems.detail: Buffer for third-party API usage (dictionary/pitch/audio sources) and periodic testing-device costs that keep the reader working across real sites.
